chunks: And Al-'Ala' narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both), who said:

"A man should not fail to say when going to sleep: 'I seek protection for myself, my offspring, my family, and my wealth with the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious evil eye' - that is what Gabriel (peace be upon him) used to seek protection with for Al-Husayn (peace be upon him)."
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite before sleeping for protection?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, establishes a Sunnah of protection before sleep, linking the recitation to the tradition of Imam al-Husayn (AS) who received it from Angel Gabriel. It emphasizes the comprehensive nature of divine protection ('Kalimat Allah al-Tammat') against both spiritual entities like Shayatin and physical harms such as beasts and the evil eye. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on utilizing revealed words for daily spiritual safeguarding.
